rule: At seed 42 only, require each primary device to have true positives, non-degenerate states and detected complete threshold events on source validation and development future. Rank by equal device/partition mean primary F1, then threshold-normalized active MAE, then relative absolute energy error. Freeze once before seeds 1019/2026; never reselect by seeds. single_mae comprises independent networks for all three devices packed exactly into a block diagonal CNN. multi_f1 selects checkpoints by mean source-validation kettle/microwave F1, then normalized MAE; all other checkpoints use original source-validation normalized MAE. Three candidates total, identical dates and input support. No final households or target confirmations for source training.
